newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia reviews business aid programmes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia reviews business aid programmes.

text.p: Australian Industry Minister John Moore announced a review on business assistance programmes on Friday.

"By working with industry to formulate a strategic approach to ensure business programmes are targeted and cost efficient, the review will contribute to responsible economic management," Moore said in a statement.
"Our aim is to establish a more consistent rationale for this area of industry policy," Moore said.
"I do not see the review as an exercise in cutting back business programmes.
"I believe the review will develop recommendations that ensure the government can meet its aim of providing effective programmes which allow industry to perform at its best."
The review will be headed by TNT Ltd chief executive David Mortimer, who will report to Moore by March.
A final report will be completed by the end of June.
